verdict.rationale: Phoenix's self-hosting docs say your data stays entirely within your infrastructure, nothing is sent to Arize, and deployments can be fully air-gapped. That structurally keeps your traces and datasets out of any Arize model training. There is, however, no explicit no-training policy statement or opt-out control. Missing for 10: an explicit data-use/no-training policy, training guarantees for any Arize-hosted offering, independent corroboration.
